paragraphs.text: No orders exist for the selected period.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000020"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="248"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">No orders exist for the selected period.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: Low Stock means some inventory remains, but the quantity has reached the configured warning level.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000060"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Low Stock means some inventory remains, but the quantity has reached the configured warning level.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: The product may still be sellable, but replenishment should be considered.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000061"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The product may still be sellable, but replenishment should be considered.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-024: How is the low-stock level decided?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000063"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="141.73228346456688" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_ixu4cgkz2ygx" w:id="26"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="26"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-024: How is the low-stock level decided?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: The warning level is normally based on a configured stock-alert threshold.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000064"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The warning level is normally based on a configured stock-alert threshold.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: The Product List includes a Batch Stock Alert Setting function for applying thresholds to selected products.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000065"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The Product List includes a Batch Stock Alert Setting function for applying thresholds to selected products.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-025: Does Low Stock mean the product cannot be sold?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000066"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="141.73228346456688" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_ycr9158swkka" w:id="27"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="27"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-025: Does Low Stock mean the product cannot be sold?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: No. It usually means the product still has stock but is approaching its warning limit.

paragraphs.text: Q-026: What does Out of Stock mean?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000068"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="141.73228346456688" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_75lw0x20hc68" w:id="28"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="28"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-026: What does Out of Stock mean?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-027: Why might a product appear out of stock when physical stock exists?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="0000006B"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="141.73228346456688" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_rk54ed39f1xk" w:id="29"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="29"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-027: Why might a product appear out of stock when physical stock exists?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: Possible reasons include:
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="0000006C"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Possible reasons include:</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Stock was not received in the ERP.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="0000006D"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="82"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Stock was not received in the ERP.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: The wrong warehouse is being checked.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="0000006E"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="82"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The wrong warehouse is being checked.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: SKU mapping is missing.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="0000006F"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="82"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">SKU mapping is missing.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Inventory synchronization failed.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000070"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="82"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Inventory synchronization failed.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Stock is locked for active orders.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000071"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="82"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Stock is locked for active orders.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: The physical count has not been recorded.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000072"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="82"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The physical count has not been recorded.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: The product is connected to the wrong Merchant SKU.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000073"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="82"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The product is connected to the wrong Merchant SKU.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-029: Where should I investigate an incorrect product total?

paragraphs.text: Q-036: Why does the Inventory Status chart show no activity?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000096"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="141.73228346456688" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_20azuachghqx" w:id="39"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="39"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-036: Why does the Inventory Status chart show no activity?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: Possible reasons include:
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000097"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Possible reasons include:</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: No stock moved during the selected period.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000098"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="214"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">No stock moved during the selected period.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Inbound records are still drafts.

paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000001C3"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_x8kg0jcjfc6e" w:id="110"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="110"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-099: Can two products use the same SKU?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: They should not use the same SKU if they represent different physical items.

paragraphs.text: Q-102: What does Select Warehouse do?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000001CE"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_aefrbd42dezk" w:id="114"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="114"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-102: What does Select Warehouse do?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: It filters products according to a selected warehouse.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000001CF"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It filters products according to a selected warehouse.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: This helps you focus on products associated with one inventory location.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000001D0"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">This helps you focus on products associated with one inventory location.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000001D1"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_bziqvx8b5j47" w:id="115"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="115"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-103: Why does the warehouse selector show a placeholder?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: A placeholder means no warehouse has been selected or no warehouse is currently available.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000001D2"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">A placeholder means no warehouse has been selected or no warehouse is currently available.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: If no warehouse exists, create one under Warehouse Management before using warehouse-based product functions.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000001D3"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">If no warehouse exists, create one under Warehouse Management before using warehouse-based product functions.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: A typical process is:

paragraphs.text: Connect the store under Store Authorization.

paragraphs.text: Synchronize or add products.

paragraphs.text: Q-112: What does the Image column show?

paragraphs.text: Answer: Possible reasons include:
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000209"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Possible reasons include:</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: The original listing has no image.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="0000020A"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="160"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The original listing has no image.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-149: What is the difference between a regular SKU and a Combine SKU?

paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000002E1"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_2aniccmrqph7" w:id="180"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="180"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-162: What does Warehouse mean for a Combine SKU?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: It identifies the warehouse whose component inventory is used to calculate bundle availability.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000002E2"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It identifies the warehouse whose component inventory is used to calculate bundle availability.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-163: How is Combine SKU stock calculated?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000002E3"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_qfrovm88935" w:id="181"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="181"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-163: How is Combine SKU stock calculated?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: Bundle availability is normally limited by the component that can make the fewest complete bundles.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000002E4"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Bundle availability is normally limited by the component that can make the fewest complete bundles.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: For example:
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000002E5"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">For example:</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: A bundle needs two units of Component A.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000002E6"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="206"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">A bundle needs two units of Component A.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: It needs one unit of Component B.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000002E7"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="206"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It needs one unit of Component B.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Component A can support five bundles.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000002E8"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="206"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Component A can support five bundles.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Component B can support three bundles.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000002E9"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="206"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Component B can support three bundles.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Only three complete bundles are available.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000002EA"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="206"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Only three complete bundles are available.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-164: Why does a Combine SKU show no stock?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000002EB"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_6udsoct13if8" w:id="182"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="182"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-164: Why does a Combine SKU show no stock?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: Possible reasons include:
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000002EC"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Possible reasons include:</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: A component is out of stock.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000002ED"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="134"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">A component is out of stock.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: There are not enough units to complete one bundle.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000002EE"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="134"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">There are not enough units to complete one bundle.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: The wrong warehouse is selected.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000002EF"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="134"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The wrong warehouse is selected.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: A component is unmapped.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000002F0"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="134"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">A component is unmapped.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Inventory synchronization is delayed.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000002F1"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="134"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Inventory synchronization is delayed.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: The bundle setup is incomplete.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000002F2"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="134"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The bundle setup is incomplete.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-165: Does creating a Combine SKU physically combine products?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000002F3"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_uo3rh6hez78w" w:id="183"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="183"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-165: Does creating a Combine SKU physically combine products?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: No. It creates a logical bundle in the ERP.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000002F4"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">No. It creates a logical bundle in the ERP.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-173: How can Product Management help my business?

paragraphs.text: Q-185: What is a Merchant SKU?

It provides one inventory identity that can be connected to one or more marketplace product SKUs.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-186: How is a Merchant SKU different from a platform SKU?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000382"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_jkzv9pxfm9tu" w:id="208"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="208"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-186: How is a Merchant SKU different from a platform SKU?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

It is a standardized product identifier that can include UPC, EAN, JAN, or ISBN formats.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-199: Why can the mapped and unmapped counts appear inconsistent with the total?

paragraphs.text: Answer: A parent product may contain several variation SKUs. One product can therefore contain both mapped and unmapped child SKUs.

paragraphs.text: Q-206: What does Mapped show?

paragraphs.text: Q-207: What does “Show child SKUs” mean?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000003F6"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_fku7m32wb35q" w:id="230"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="230"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-207: What does “Show child SKUs” mean?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: It expands a parent product to display its variation-level SKUs.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000003F7"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It expands a parent product to display its variation-level SKUs.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: For example, a product may show “10 variant SKU(s).” Opening the child SKUs should reveal each variation and its mapping.

paragraphs.text: Q-208: What is Auto Mapping?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000003FA"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_8bc5a4s44yin" w:id="231"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="231"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-208: What is Auto Mapping?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: Auto Mapping attempts to connect platform SKUs to Merchant SKUs using matching information, usually SKU codes or another identifier.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000003FB"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Auto Mapping attempts to connect platform SKUs to Merchant SKUs using matching information, usually SKU codes or another identifier.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Automatic results should be reviewed because similar names or reused codes can cause incorrect matches.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000003FC"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Automatic results should be reviewed because similar names or reused codes can cause incorrect matches.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-216: What is a Sync Group?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000424"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-216: What is a Sync Group?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: A Sync Group links related marketplace SKUs so inventory updates can be coordinated through a common Merchant SKU or group.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000425"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">A Sync Group links related marketplace SKUs so inventory updates can be coordinated through a common Merchant SKU or group.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: The precise synchronization rule should be confirmed before changing the group.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000426"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The precise synchronization rule should be confirmed before changing the group.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-217: What does “View/change mapped platform SKU list” do?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000427"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_isln4duowv07" w:id="240"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="240"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-217: What does “View/change mapped platform SKU list” do?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: It opens the platform SKUs connected to the Merchant SKU and may allow those mappings to be changed.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000428"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It opens the platform SKUs connected to the Merchant SKU and may allow those mappings to be changed.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Changing a mapping can redirect inventory synchronization, so verify every SKU before saving.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000429"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Changing a mapping can redirect inventory synchronization, so verify every SKU before saving.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-218: What does “Unlink mapped product SKU(s)” do?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="0000042B"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_459ez6pqox8z" w:id="241"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="241"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-218: What does “Unlink mapped product SKU(s)” do?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: It removes one or more platform SKU connections from the Merchant SKU.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="0000042C"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It removes one or more platform SKU connections from the Merchant SKU.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Unlinking can interrupt inventory synchronization for those products. It should only be used with explicit authorization.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="0000042D"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Unlinking can interrupt inventory synchronization for those products. It should only be used with explicit authorization.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-219: What does “Group sync child SKUs” do?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="0000042E"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_66ankxj510lz" w:id="242"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="242"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-219: What does “Group sync child SKUs” do?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: It appears to coordinate inventory synchronization for child or variation SKUs belonging to a mapping group.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="0000042F"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It appears to coordinate inventory synchronization for child or variation SKUs belonging to a mapping group.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Confirm the affected SKUs and stock behavior before using it.

paragraphs.text: Q-220: Why is a Merchant SKU unmapped?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000431"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_y50807fomyb8" w:id="243"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="243"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-220: Why is a Merchant SKU unmapped?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: Possible reasons include:
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000432"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Possible reasons include:</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: It was created manually but never linked.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000433"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="133"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It was created manually but never linked.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: The platform product was removed.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000434"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="133"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The platform product was removed.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: The marketplace SKU changed.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000435"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="133"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The marketplace SKU changed.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Product synchronization is incomplete.

paragraphs.text: Answer: Lock Quantity is inventory reserved or temporarily unavailable, often because of pending orders or processing operations.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="0000044E"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Lock Quantity is inventory reserved or temporarily unavailable, often because of pending orders or processing operations.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: A simplified available-stock calculation may be:

paragraphs.text: Q-226: Why is stock locked?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000452"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_lzp7la3i62w6" w:id="250"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="250"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-226: Why is stock locked?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: Common reasons include:
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000453"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Common reasons include:</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: An order reserved the item.
