paragraphs.text: The order is being packed or processed.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000455"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="112"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The order is being packed or processed.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: An outbound operation is pending.

paragraphs.text: Q-227: What does Stock Alert mean?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000459"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_ysko6erycszt" w:id="251"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="251"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-227: What does Stock Alert mean?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-230: What does Last Sync mean?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000468"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_8iukczcej9bv" w:id="255"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="255"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-230: What does Last Sync mean?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000469"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It shows when the ERP last synchronized the inventory record.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-231: What do All, Unmapped, and Mapped mean?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="0000046B"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_638wsagrbvdu" w:id="256"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="256"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-231: What do All, Unmapped, and Mapped mean?</w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: Mapped records have the required SKU relationship. Unmapped records require review before inventory can reliably synchronize.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="0000046C"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: Mapped records have the required SKU relationship. Unmapped records require review before inventory can reliably synchronize.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-263: Why does the Outbound Draft page say “No items found”?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="0000050D"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_qyotnkc7wawh" w:id="291"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="291"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-263: Why does the Outbound Draft page say “No items found”?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: It means no draft records match the current filters.

paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="0000052E"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It records how many units were added in that transaction.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: A zero means the transaction did not add stock.

paragraphs.text: Answer: Purpose explains why the inventory changed.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000534"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Purpose explains why the inventory changed.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Visible entries included “Sales deduction,” meaning inventory was reduced because of a sale.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000535"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Visible entries included “Sales deduction,” meaning inventory was reduced because of a sale.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-272: What does Remaining Quantity mean?

paragraphs.text: Answer: It is the quantity recorded after that transaction was applied.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000537"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It is the quantity recorded after that transaction was applied.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Reading records chronologically helps explain how the current balance was reached.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000538"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Reading records chronologically helps explain how the current balance was reached.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-273: What does Operation Time mean?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000539"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_cf0ncfl6j8ou" w:id="302"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="302"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-273: What does Operation Time mean?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: It is the recorded date and time when the stock movement was processed.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="0000053A"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It is the recorded date and time when the stock movement was processed.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: If the time differs from the order time, synchronization or processing may have occurred later.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="0000053B"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">If the time differs from the order time, synchronization or processing may have occurred later.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-276: Why should I select a warehouse?

paragraphs.text: Q-283: What is the purpose of Order Management?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000576"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_2z6d0gl5hs0" w:id="314"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="314"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-283: What is the purpose of Order Management?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000577"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It manages orders from the time they enter the ERP until they are packed, transferred to fulfillment, shipped, delivered, returned, or cancelled.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: It restricts results to a selected time period.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005A9"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It restricts results to a selected time period.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Regular order-processing pages provide a recent-period filter such as Last 7 Days. Return Orders provides a longer period such as Last 1 Month.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005AA"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Regular order-processing pages provide a recent-period filter such as Last 7 Days. Return Orders provides a longer period such as Last 1 Month.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-294: Why can’t I find an older order?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005AC"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_b7hbol2fvu81" w:id="326"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="326"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-294: Why can’t I find an older order?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: Possible reasons include:
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005AD"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Possible reasons include:</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: The date filter is too narrow.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005AE"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="25"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The date filter is too narrow.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: The wrong store is selected.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005AF"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="25"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The wrong store is selected.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: The wrong platform is selected.

paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005C2"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_u3jpd88r5nv" w:id="332"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="332"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-299: What does SKU mean in an order?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: It identifies the product or variation included in the order.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005C3"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It identifies the product or variation included in the order.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: The platform SKU should be mapped to the correct Merchant SKU for reliable inventory handling.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005C4"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The platform SKU should be mapped to the correct Merchant SKU for reliable inventory handling.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-300: What is the Order Number?

paragraphs.text: It is generally one of the best references for locating a specific transaction.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005C7"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It is generally one of the best references for locating a specific transaction.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-301: What is the Platform column?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005C8"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_wm0c2v5cu54f" w:id="334"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="334"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-301: What is the Platform column?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: It identifies the marketplace from which the order originated.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005C9"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It identifies the marketplace from which the order originated.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-302: What is the Store column?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005CA"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_r4kc8650v7w" w:id="335"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="335"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-302: What is the Store column?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: It identifies the authorized marketplace store that received the order.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005CB"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It identifies the authorized marketplace store that received the order.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-303: What is the Warehouse Package Number?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005CC"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_m6o44ivp3u8i" w:id="336"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="336"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-303: What is the Warehouse Package Number?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: It is the ERP or warehouse reference for the package prepared during fulfillment.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005CD"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It is the ERP or warehouse reference for the package prepared during fulfillment.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: It may differ from the marketplace order number and courier tracking number.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005CE"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It may differ from the marketplace order number and courier tracking number.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-304: What is a Tracking Number?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005CF"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_o1bbzgqony2v" w:id="337"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="337"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-304: What is a Tracking Number?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: It is the courier’s shipment identifier. It is used to follow the parcel after booking or dispatch.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005D0"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It is the courier’s shipment identifier. It is used to follow the parcel after booking or dispatch.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-305: Why might the tracking number be missing?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005D1"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_amhx77cfiyuj" w:id="338"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="338"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-305: Why might the tracking number be missing?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005E0"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Details opens additional information about the selected order.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: It may include products, quantities, addresses, shipment information, status history, and other order-level information.

paragraphs.text: Answer: It indicates that packing did not complete successfully.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005FF"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It indicates that packing did not complete successfully.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Possible causes include unavailable stock, missing mapping, invalid order data, warehouse problems, or a system error.

paragraphs.text: Check SKU Mapping, Inventory List, Lock Quantity, and the selected warehouse.

paragraphs.text: Answer: It identifies orders where a product SKU may need to be replaced or supplemented.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000605"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It identifies orders where a product SKU may need to be replaced or supplemented.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Any substitute should match the intended product and be authorized before processing.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000606"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Any substitute should match the intended product and be authorized before processing.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-319: What does Platform Processing mean?

paragraphs.text: Answer: It indicates that the marketplace is still processing the order or that the ERP is waiting for a platform-side result.

paragraphs.text: Answer: Possible reasons include:
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="0000060A"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Possible reasons include:</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: No order is selected.

paragraphs.text: The order is not eligible for packing.

paragraphs.text: Inventory is unavailable.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="0000060D"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="210"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Inventory is unavailable.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Required mapping is missing.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="0000060E"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="210"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Required mapping is missing.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: The marketplace is still processing it.

paragraphs.text: The user lacks permission.

Processed Orders</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-321: What is the Processed Orders page?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000612"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_glglt45w0374" w:id="356"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="356"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-321: What is the Processed Orders page?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-322: What does Push do?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000614"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_tjdf1dfghzf9" w:id="357"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="357"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-322: What does Push do?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: Push sends selected processed orders to the next connected fulfillment, warehouse, marketplace, or logistics stage.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000615"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Push sends selected processed orders to the next connected fulfillment, warehouse, marketplace, or logistics stage.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: The exact destination depends on the ERP configuration.

paragraphs.text: Answer: It indicates that the ERP has started the push request but has not yet received a final result.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000621"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It indicates that the ERP has started the push request but has not yet received a final result.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Avoid repeating the operation until the existing request finishes or fails.

paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000636"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_ok7vb358xi3m" w:id="366"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="366"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-330: What does Move to Shipped do?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000637"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It manually advances selected orders from the pickup stage to the shipped stage.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Only use it after confirming that the parcel has actually been handed over or dispatched.

paragraphs.text: Answer: Possible reasons include:

paragraphs.text: Q-335: Why might a shipped order not move to Completed?

paragraphs.text: Answer: Possible reasons include:

paragraphs.text: The parcel is on hold.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000651"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="183"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The parcel is on hold.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: The order is being returned.

paragraphs.text: Manual confirmation is required.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000654"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="183"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Manual confirmation is required.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-336: Where should I check shipment progress?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000655"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_427oyw8yl9gg" w:id="373"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="373"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-336: Where should I check shipment progress?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: Use the tracking number with the connected courier or review the order’s Details and status information.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000656"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Use the tracking number with the connected courier or review the order’s Details and status information.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-337: Can shipped orders still be cancelled?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000657"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_ep4yrdb7puw4" w:id="374"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="374"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-337: Can shipped orders still be cancelled?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: Cancellation after shipment may not be possible through the normal cancellation workflow. It may require courier interception, return handling, or marketplace support.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000658"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Cancellation after shipment may not be possible through the normal cancellation workflow. It may require courier interception, return handling, or marketplace support.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: H. Completed Orders
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000659"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading2"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:after="80" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:sz w:val="34"/><w:szCs w:val="34"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_7kx0tk2flwdx" w:id="375"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="375"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:sz w:val="34"/><w:szCs w:val="34"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">H. Completed Orders</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-338: What is the Completed Orders page?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="0000065A"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_qrptsva3syg5" w:id="376"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="376"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-338: What is the Completed Orders page?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: It contains orders whose normal fulfillment lifecycle has finished.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="0000065B"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It contains orders whose normal fulfillment lifecycle has finished.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Depending on the platform, completion may mean delivered, buyer-confirmed, or finalized after a settlement period.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="0000065C"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Depending on the platform, completion may mean delivered, buyer-confirmed, or finalized after a settlement period.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-339: Does Completed always mean payment was settled?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="0000065D"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_54spg5nrqqtu" w:id="377"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="377"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-339: Does Completed always mean payment was settled?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: Not necessarily. Delivery completion and financial settlement can be separate marketplace events.

Delivery completion and financial settlement can be separate marketplace events.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-340: Can a completed order still be returned?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="0000065F"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-340: Can a completed order still be returned?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: Yes. Marketplaces can permit returns or refunds after delivery, subject to their policies.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000660"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Yes. Marketplaces can permit returns or refunds after delivery, subject to their policies.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: A later return record may therefore exist for a completed order.

paragraphs.text: Answer: It requests updated return information from connected marketplaces.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000694"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It requests updated return information from connected marketplaces.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: This can update local return records and should only be used when synchronization is intended.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000695"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">This can update local return records and should only be used when synchronization is intended.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-351: What does Add Manual Return Order do?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000696"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_29bxem2zcnyf" w:id="390"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="390"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-351: What does Add Manual Return Order do?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: It begins the creation of a return record that was not imported automatically.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000697"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It begins the creation of a return record that was not imported automatically.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Before submitting it, verify the original order, returned SKU, quantity, reason, warehouse, and inventory treatment.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000698"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Before submitting it, verify the original order, returned SKU, quantity, reason, warehouse, and inventory treatment.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: A manually created order was returned.

paragraphs.text: Q-353: Does a return automatically restore inventory?

paragraphs.text: Answer: Not always. Returned inventory may need inspection before it is considered sellable.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000006A1"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Not always. Returned inventory may need inspection before it is considered sellable.</w:t></w:r></w:p>
