paragraphs.text: Q-405: How should I choose a warehouse name?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000007A3"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_ckqfnkedduvd" w:id="451"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="451"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-405: How should I choose a warehouse name?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: Use a name that clearly identifies the location and avoids confusion.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000007A4"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Use a name that clearly identifies the location and avoids confusion.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: A useful naming pattern is:
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000007A5"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">A useful naming pattern is:</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Country/Region – City – Warehouse Type
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000007A6"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Roboto Mono" w:cs="Roboto Mono" w:eastAsia="Roboto Mono" w:hAnsi="Roboto Mono"/><w:color w:val="188038"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Roboto Mono" w:cs="Roboto Mono" w:eastAsia="Roboto Mono" w:hAnsi="Roboto Mono"/><w:color w:val="188038"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Country/Region – City – Warehouse Type</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: For example:
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000007A7"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">For example:</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-406: Can two warehouses have the same name?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000007AB"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_st4juwhkcc0t" w:id="452"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="452"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-406: Can two warehouses have the same name?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: The system may technically permit similar names, but duplicate names create operational confusion.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000007AC"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The system may technically permit similar names, but duplicate names create operational confusion.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Use a unique name for each physical or logical inventory location.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000007AD"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Use a unique name for each physical or logical inventory location.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-407: What is a warehouse attribute?

paragraphs.text: A virtual warehouse should only be created when it represents a real operational need, such as consignment stock or marketplace-managed stock.

paragraphs.text: The warehouse is normally created only after the required information is entered and the final save or submit action is completed.

paragraphs.text: Q-413: Can adding a warehouse affect existing stock?

paragraphs.text: Answer: Creating an empty warehouse should not move existing stock automatically.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000007CE"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Creating an empty warehouse should not move existing stock automatically.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: However, assigning SKUs, importing quantities, or changing the default warehouse can affect later operations.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000007CF"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">However, assigning SKUs, importing quantities, or changing the default warehouse can affect later operations.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-414: What does Warehouse Name mean?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000007D1"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_vpk6nz14fcql" w:id="461"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="461"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-414: What does Warehouse Name mean?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: It is the primary label used to identify the warehouse throughout the ERP.

paragraphs.text: Q-417: What does Total SKU mean?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000007DA"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_2kdbd3sb20ts" w:id="464"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="464"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-417: What does Total SKU mean?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: It represents the number of SKU records associated with that warehouse.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000007DB"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It represents the number of SKU records associated with that warehouse.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: It should not automatically be interpreted as the total number of physical units.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000007DC"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It should not automatically be interpreted as the total number of physical units.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-418: What is the difference between Total SKU and total inventory quantity?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000007DD"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_w3rvey89qhys" w:id="465"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="465"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-418: What is the difference between Total SKU and total inventory quantity?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: Total SKU counts distinct inventory identities or warehouse SKU records.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000007DE"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="192"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Total SKU counts distinct inventory identities or warehouse SKU records.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Total inventory quantity counts physical units.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000007DF"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="192"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Total inventory quantity counts physical units.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: For example, one warehouse could contain 10 SKUs with 100 units of each. Total SKU would be 10, while total units would be 1,000.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000007E0"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">For example, one warehouse could contain 10 SKUs with 100 units of each. Total SKU would be 10, while total units would be 1,000.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-419: Why might Total SKU be zero?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000007E2"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_afig28pjm1qt" w:id="466"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="466"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-419: Why might Total SKU be zero?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: Possible reasons include:

paragraphs.text: Answer: They move between warehouse-list pages.

paragraphs.text: Changing it affects only the display and does not modify warehouse records.

paragraphs.text: Q-473: What does Days Left mean?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000918"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_jtznkqy1etc7" w:id="530"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="530"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-473: What does Days Left mean?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: It indicates how long the store’s current subscription remains active.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000919"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It indicates how long the store’s current subscription remains active.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: If it approaches zero, marketplace operations may be interrupted.

paragraphs.text: Q-499: How can I safely reauthorize a store?

paragraphs.text: Answer: A safe process is:
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="0000099E"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">A safe process is:</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Confirm the correct store.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="0000099F"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="217"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Confirm the correct store.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Check active orders.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000009A0"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="217"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Check active orders.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Open the store’s Actions menu.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000009A1"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="217"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Open the store’s Actions menu.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Choose the reauthorization option, if available.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000009A2"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="217"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Choose the reauthorization option, if available.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000009A3"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="217"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Verify the official marketplace domain.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Sign in as the authorized store owner.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000009A4"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="217"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Sign in as the authorized store owner.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Review requested permissions.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000009A5"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="217"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Review requested permissions.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-500: What is a Sub Account?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000009A9"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_abq3dun6zgw5" w:id="559"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="559"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-500: What is a Sub Account?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: A Sub Account is an additional ERP user operating under the main account.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000009AA"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">A Sub Account is an additional ERP user operating under the main account.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: It allows staff members to use their own login and assigned permissions.

paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000009E2"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_ip0u3yxw2dr8" w:id="569"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="569"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-510: What is least-privilege access?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: It means giving users only the permissions required for their work.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000009E3"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It means giving users only the permissions required for their work.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: For example, warehouse staff may not need subscription or account-management access.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000009E4"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">For example, warehouse staff may not need subscription or account-management access.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-511: Should several employees share one Sub Account?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000009E5"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_i74jznvh8mno" w:id="570"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="570"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-511: Should several employees share one Sub Account?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: No. Each employee should have an individual account whenever possible.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000009E6"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">No. Each employee should have an individual account whenever possible.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Shared accounts reduce accountability and make access removal more difficult.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000009E7"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Shared accounts reduce accountability and make access removal more difficult.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-512: How should a Sub Account password be created?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000009E8"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_37hsww40et31" w:id="571"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="571"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-512: How should a Sub Account password be created?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: Use a strong, unique password that is not reused elsewhere.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000009E9"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Use a strong, unique password that is not reused elsewhere.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: If the ERP supports invitations or password setup by the user, that is preferable to sending a password in a message.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000009EA"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">If the ERP supports invitations or password setup by the user, that is preferable to sending a password in a message.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-513: Should the administrator know every user’s password?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000009EB"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_ukwg17ktrxk" w:id="572"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="572"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-513: Should the administrator know every user’s password?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: No. Users should control their own passwords. Administrators should use authorized reset or invitation workflows when access must be restored.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000009EC"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">No. Users should control their own passwords. Administrators should use authorized reset or invitation workflows when access must be restored.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-516: What should happen when an employee leaves?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000009F4"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_g2kqexrpelzq" w:id="575"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="575"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-516: What should happen when an employee leaves?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: An authorized administrator should promptly disable or remove the person’s access according to company policy.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000009F5"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">An authorized administrator should promptly disable or remove the person’s access according to company policy.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Before removal, consider whether audit history must remain linked to that user.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000009F6"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Before removal, consider whether audit history must remain linked to that user.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-517: Should I delete or disable a former employee’s account?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000009F7"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_jb8k9tc5ymtv" w:id="576"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="576"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-517: Should I delete or disable a former employee’s account?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: Disabling is often safer because it blocks access while preserving the user record and history.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000009F8"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Disabling is often safer because it blocks access while preserving the user record and history.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Deletion may be appropriate only when retention and audit requirements permit it.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000009F9"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Deletion may be appropriate only when retention and audit requirements permit it.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-518: Can a Sub Account manage other accounts?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000009FA"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_lnltr3tl9wjo" w:id="577"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="577"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-518: Can a Sub Account manage other accounts?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: This permission should be restricted carefully.

paragraphs.text: Q-519: Can a Sub Account view customer information?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000009FD"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_m1eqgu7coucn" w:id="578"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="578"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-519: Can a Sub Account view customer information?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-528: What is Role Name?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000A2E"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_ua42qzv3gta8" w:id="588"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="588"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-528: What is Role Name?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: It is the label describing the role’s intended responsibility.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000A2F"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It is the label describing the role’s intended responsibility.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Use clear names such as “Warehouse Operator” rather than vague names such as “Role 1.”
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000A30"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Use clear names such as “Warehouse Operator” rather than vague names such as “Role 1.”</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-529: What does Sub Account Linking Status mean?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000A31"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_ekvcjgq0nb2h" w:id="589"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="589"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-529: What does Sub Account Linking Status mean?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: It shows whether the role is currently assigned to one or more Sub Accounts.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000A32"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It shows whether the role is currently assigned to one or more Sub Accounts.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: A linked role can affect active users.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000A33"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">A linked role can affect active users.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-530: What does “Linked” mean?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000A34"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_v23803nybfi" w:id="590"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="590"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-530: What does “Linked” mean?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: It means at least one Sub Account is using the role.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000A35"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It means at least one Sub Account is using the role.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Changing that role may change permissions for every linked user.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000A36"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Changing that role may change permissions for every linked user.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-531: What does “Not Linked” mean?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000A37"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_qlrc6qqw41c0" w:id="591"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="591"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-531: What does “Not Linked” mean?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: It means no Sub Account is currently assigned to the role.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000A38"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It means no Sub Account is currently assigned to the role.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: The role may be unused, newly created, or retained for future use.

paragraphs.text: Answer: Usually not, unless their job includes store connections, user administration, or role management.

paragraphs.text: They may only need warehouse and inventory functions.

paragraphs.text: Q-549: What should I do if a user urgently needs temporary access?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000A92"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_9qggsg2v7j5a" w:id="609"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="609"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-549: What should I do if a user urgently needs temporary access?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: Prefer a time-limited or narrowly scoped role if the ERP supports it.

paragraphs.text: For example, a TikTok store cannot be selected until TikTok is checked.

paragraphs.text: Q-560: What happens after I select a platform?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000ACA"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_xgmxuotncmyj" w:id="623"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="623"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-560: What happens after I select a platform?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: The stores belonging to that marketplace become available for selection.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000ACB"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The stores belonging to that marketplace become available for selection.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: The platform checkbox does not itself purchase a subscription.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000ACC"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The platform checkbox does not itself purchase a subscription.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-561: Can I change the selected platform before checkout?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000ACD"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_rkdju5pufsfu" w:id="624"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="624"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-561: Can I change the selected platform before checkout?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: Yes. You should be able to select or clear platform checkboxes before choosing a plan.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000ACE"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Yes. You should be able to select or clear platform checkboxes before choosing a plan.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: After every change, review the selected stores and amount again.

paragraphs.text: Q-562: Why is my platform not listed?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000AD0"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_9gsuvk1tt4d8" w:id="625"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="625"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-562: Why is my platform not listed?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: Possible reasons include:
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000AD1"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Possible reasons include:</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: The ERP does not support that marketplace.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000AD2"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="73"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The ERP does not support that marketplace.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: No corresponding integration is installed.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000AD3"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="73"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">No corresponding integration is installed.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: The platform is unavailable in the selected region.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000AD4"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="73"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The platform is unavailable in the selected region.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: The account lacks the required feature.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000AD5"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="73"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The account lacks the required feature.</w:t></w:r></w:p>
