paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000AD6"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="73"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The pricing page currently supports only listed platforms.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-563: Does selecting a platform authorize a store?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000AD7"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_9og6a1m6mbyp" w:id="626"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="626"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-563: Does selecting a platform authorize a store?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: No. Platform selection on the pricing page only determines which stores can receive a plan.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000AD8"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">No. Platform selection on the pricing page only determines which stores can receive a plan.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Store authorization is managed separately under:
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000AD9"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Store authorization is managed separately under:</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: System Configuration → Store Authorization

paragraphs.text: Q-564: Why must I select a store?

paragraphs.text: Answer: Subscriptions appear to be associated with individual marketplace stores.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000ADD"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Subscriptions appear to be associated with individual marketplace stores.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: The ERP needs to know which store or stores the plan should cover.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000ADE"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The ERP needs to know which store or stores the plan should cover.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-565: How do I select a store?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000ADF"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_al5mhiiq4tlr" w:id="629"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="629"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-565: How do I select a store?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000AE0"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">First select its platform. Then select the checkbox beside the required store.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-566: Can I select more than one store?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000AE1"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_p6v5ea9j7lfp" w:id="630"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="630"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-566: Can I select more than one store?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: The page uses checkboxes, so multiple-store selection may be supported.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000AE2"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The page uses checkboxes, so multiple-store selection may be supported.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: The amount summary should update according to the number of selected stores.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000AE3"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The amount summary should update according to the number of selected stores.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-567: What does the store count in the amount summary mean?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000AE4"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_h6wo4l5605ml" w:id="631"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="631"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-567: What does the store count in the amount summary mean?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: It indicates how many stores are included in the current subscription selection.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000AE5"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It indicates how many stores are included in the current subscription selection.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Verify this count before choosing a plan.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000AE6"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Verify this count before choosing a plan.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-568: Why does the amount change when I select another store?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000AE7"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_xt8vlogxgsm" w:id="632"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="632"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-568: Why does the amount change when I select another store?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: The pricing appears to be calculated per selected store.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000AE8"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The pricing appears to be calculated per selected store.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Adding more stores may multiply or otherwise increase the total price.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000AE9"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Adding more stores may multiply or otherwise increase the total price.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-569: Can different stores use different plans?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000AEA"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_tddb3yrqiach" w:id="633"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="633"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-569: Can different stores use different plans?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: The page applies the selected plan to the current platform/store selection.

paragraphs.text: Answer: It may change the displayed price using the ERP’s configured regional pricing or conversion rules.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000B32"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It may change the displayed price using the ERP’s configured regional pricing or conversion rules.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Do not assume it uses the live foreign-exchange rate.

paragraphs.text: Q-642: Can I manage stores from different countries?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000C6E"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_4ovkyw39odsy" w:id="713"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="713"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-642: Can I manage stores from different countries?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: The ERP supports country information and multiple regional currencies. Actual marketplace availability and billing eligibility should be verified for each country.

Actual marketplace availability and billing eligibility should be verified for each country.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-643: How will it help if I expand into another marketplace?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000C70"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_cymk48s8a46o" w:id="714"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="714"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-643: How will it help if I expand into another marketplace?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: A centralized ERP can make expansion easier by providing a common approach to SKUs, inventory, warehouses, orders, and staff access.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000C71"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">A centralized ERP can make expansion easier by providing a common approach to SKUs, inventory, warehouses, orders, and staff access.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Confirm that the new marketplace is supported before planning the expansion.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000C72"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Confirm that the new marketplace is supported before planning the expansion.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-644: Can the ERP accept marketplace orders automatically?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000C73"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_yigo0r1t719f" w:id="715"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="715"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-644: Can the ERP accept marketplace orders automatically?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: Store Authorization includes an Auto Order Accept setting.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000C74"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Store Authorization includes an Auto Order Accept setting.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Use it only when inventory accuracy, mappings, fulfillment capacity, and company policy support automatic acceptance.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000C75"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Use it only when inventory accuracy, mappings, fulfillment capacity, and company policy support automatic acceptance.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-645: Why would I enable Auto Order Accept?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000C76"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_vt0hhpkeulkx" w:id="716"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="716"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-645: Why would I enable Auto Order Accept?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: It can reduce manual work and help the business respond quickly when marketplaces impose short acceptance deadlines.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000C77"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It can reduce manual work and help the business respond quickly when marketplaces impose short acceptance deadlines.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-646: When should I avoid automatic acceptance?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000C78"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_vr9fr9myj6wl" w:id="717"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="717"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-646: When should I avoid automatic acceptance?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: Avoid it when:
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000C79"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Avoid it when:</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Inventory is unreliable.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000C7A"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="101"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Inventory is unreliable.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Products are frequently unmapped.

paragraphs.text: Q-729: When will my referral code appear?

paragraphs.text: Answer: Normally, a referral code does not expire automatically.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000DFE"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Normally, a referral code does not expire automatically.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: However, after someone successfully uses that code to purchase a plan, the code becomes invalid and cannot be used again.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000DFF"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">However, after someone successfully uses that code to purchase a plan, the code becomes invalid and cannot be used again.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000E18"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The ERP copies the referral code to your device’s clipboard.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: You can then paste it into a message.

paragraphs.text: Q-751: How can I become eligible for a gift?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000E39"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_j9e4ctlnm4fd" w:id="835"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="835"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-751: How can I become eligible for a gift?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: Share an unused referral code with a friend.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000E3A"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Share an unused referral code with a friend.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: You become eligible when your friend uses that code to purchase an eligible subscription lasting at least one year.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000E3B"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">You become eligible when your friend uses that code to purchase an eligible subscription lasting at least one year.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-752: Which plan duration qualifies for a gift?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000E3C"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_1lytp0dmxj5q" w:id="836"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="836"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-752: Which plan duration qualifies for a gift?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: The person using your referral code must purchase a plan for one year or longer.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000E3D"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The person using your referral code must purchase a plan for one year or longer.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: This includes eligible one-year and two-year premium subscriptions.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000E3E"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">This includes eligible one-year and two-year premium subscriptions.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-753: Will I receive a gift if someone purchases a plan for less than one year?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000E3F"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_895xxkmizq60" w:id="837"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="837"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-753: Will I receive a gift if someone purchases a plan for less than one year?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: No. A plan shorter than one year does not qualify you for the referral gift.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000E40"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">No. A plan shorter than one year does not qualify you for the referral gift.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-756: Is the gift guaranteed immediately after my friend pays?
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000E47"><w:pPr><w:pStyle w:val="Heading3"/><w:keepNext w:val="0"/><w:keepLines w:val="0"/><w:spacing w:before="280" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:bookmarkStart w:colFirst="0" w:colLast="0" w:name="_cydf7xibv2ia" w:id="840"/><w:bookmarkEnd w:id="840"/><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:b w:val="1"/><w:bCs w:val="1"/><w:color w:val="000000"/><w:sz w:val="26"/><w:szCs w:val="26"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Q-756: Is the gift guaranteed immediately after my friend pays?</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Answer: Eligibility depends on successful use of your referral code and successful payment for a qualifying plan.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000E48"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Eligibility depends on successful use of your referral code and successful payment for a qualifying plan.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: The ERP may need time to confirm the transaction and prepare the gift.
paragraphs.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000E49"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The ERP may need time to confirm the transaction and prepare the gift.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

paragraphs.text: Q-757: What happens if my friend’s payment fails?

paragraphs.text: Q-786: Can the referral program guarantee new customers?

<w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000F97"><w:pPr><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:sz w:val="21"/><w:szCs w:val="21"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr></w:r></w:p>

<w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000F9D"><w:pPr><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:sz w:val="21"/><w:szCs w:val="21"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr></w:r></w:p>

questions.question: What is the Dashboard?

body.text: Answer: The Dashboard is the main summary page of the ERP. It gives you a quick view of products, orders, inventory activity, sales trends, and store subscriptions.

body.text: Answer: Product Management contains the product catalog and combined-product bundles.

questions.question: What is Inventory Management?

body.text: Answer: Inventory Management controls Merchant SKUs, SKU mappings, warehouse quantities, inbound stock, outbound stock, and inventory history.

body.text: Answer: Order Management controls order processing, shipping stages, returns, cancellations, and manual orders.

body.text: Answer: It represents products connected or synchronized from supported marketplace stores.

body.text: Answer: Low Stock means some inventory remains, but the quantity has reached the configured warning level.

questions.question: What does Stock-In mean?

body.text: Answer: Stock-In represents inventory added to a warehouse.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000089"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Stock-In represents inventory added to a warehouse.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: It can include completed inbound or manual receiving transactions.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="0000008A"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It can include completed inbound or manual receiving transactions.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

questions.question: What does Stock-Out mean?

body.text: Answer: Stock-Out represents inventory removed from a warehouse.

body.text: It can include order fulfillment, outbound operations, or other stock deductions.

questions.question: Does Stock-In include inventory that is still On The Way?

body.text: Answer: Not necessarily. Inventory may need to be received or completed before it is counted as available stock.

Inventory may need to be received or completed before it is counted as available stock.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: Answer: Processing Orders are being prepared, packed, pushed, or moved through the fulfillment workflow.

body.text: Answer: Shipped Orders have been dispatched but are not yet considered completed.

questions.question: Does opening Product Management change anything?

body.text: Answer: No. Viewing, searching, filtering, and changing pages do not normally modify product information.

body.text: Answer: They should not use the same SKU if they represent different physical items.

questions.question: Does Product Management directly control warehouse stock?

body.text: Answer: Product Management displays inventory-related information, but stock movements are mainly managed through Inventory Management.

questions.question: What does the checkbox in each row do?

body.text: Answer: It selects that product for a possible batch operation.

body.text: Answer: It selects all product rows displayed on the current page.

questions.question: What does Add Products do?

body.text: Answer: Add Products begins the workflow for adding or importing products into the ERP.

questions.question: Does clicking Add Products immediately create a product?

body.text: Answer: No. It should first open a product-addition workflow.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="0000026F"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">No. It should first open a product-addition workflow.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: A product is normally created only after the required information is completed and submitted.

body.text: Answer: No. It should first open the bundle-creation workflow.

body.text: Answer: Use a unique code that clearly identifies the bundle.

body.text: Answer: Bundle availability is normally limited by the component that can make the fewest complete bundles.

questions.question: Does creating a Combine SKU physically combine products?

body.text: Answer: No. It creates a logical bundle in the ERP.

body.text: Answer: It should reduce the inventory of the bundle’s component SKUs according to their configured quantities.

body.text: Answer: It creates a central place for product identification, inventory visibility, product bundles, and marketplace-related product operations.

questions.question: What is a Merchant SKU?

body.text: Answer: A Merchant SKU is the ERP’s internal stock identifier. It provides one inventory identity that can be connected to one or more marketplace product SKUs.

It provides one inventory identity that can be connected to one or more marketplace product SKUs.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

questions.question: What is GTIN?

body.text: Answer: GTIN means Global Trade Item Number. It is a standardized product identifier that can include UPC, EAN, JAN, or ISBN formats.

questions.question: What is Auto Mapping?

body.text: Answer: Auto Mapping attempts to connect platform SKUs to Merchant SKUs using matching information, usually SKU codes or another identifier.

body.text: Automatic results should be reviewed because similar names or reused codes can cause incorrect matches.

questions.question: What does Generate Merchant SKU do?

body.text: Answer: It creates Merchant SKUs from selected marketplace products or SKUs.

questions.question: What does Mapped Stores mean?

body.text: Answer: It identifies the stores whose product SKUs are connected to the Merchant SKU.

questions.question: What is a Sync Group?

body.text: Answer: A Sync Group links related marketplace SKUs so inventory updates can be coordinated through a common Merchant SKU or group.

questions.question: What does “View/change mapped platform SKU list” do?

body.text: Answer: It opens the platform SKUs connected to the Merchant SKU and may allow those mappings to be changed.

questions.question: What does “Unlink mapped product SKU(s)” do?

body.text: Answer: It removes one or more platform SKU connections from the Merchant SKU.

body.text: Unlinking can interrupt inventory synchronization for those products. It should only be used with explicit authorization.

questions.question: What does “Group sync child SKUs” do?

body.text: Answer: It appears to coordinate inventory synchronization for child or variation SKUs belonging to a mapping group.

body.text: Answer: The Inventory List shows warehouse-level quantities and synchronization status for inventory records.

body.text: Answer: One Merchant SKU can have inventory records in multiple warehouses.

body.text: Answer: Quantity is the recorded stock amount for that SKU in the specified warehouse.

questions.question: What does Out of Sync mean?

body.text: Answer: Out of Sync means the ERP inventory and connected platform may not currently agree or that the latest synchronization failed.

questions.question: What does Last Sync mean?

body.text: Answer: It shows when the ERP last synchronized the inventory record.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000469"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It shows when the ERP last synchronized the inventory record.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: An old timestamp may indicate a synchronization delay or inactive connection.

questions.question: What do All, Unmapped, and Mapped mean?

body.text: Answer: Mapped records have the required SKU relationship. Unmapped records require review before inventory can reliably synchronize.

questions.question: Why does a SKU show zero quantity but still appear in the Inventory List?

body.text: Answer: Inventory records remain useful even when their quantity is zero. The record preserves the warehouse association, mapping, sync status, and stock history.

questions.question: What is Manual Inbound?

body.text: Answer: Manual Inbound records stock received outside the regular inbound-shipment workflow.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000484"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Manual Inbound records stock received outside the regular inbound-shipment workflow.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: It may be used for adjustments, local deliveries, supplier receipts, or other manually recorded stock arrivals.

questions.question: When does inbound stock become available?

body.text: Answer: Normally, stock becomes available when receiving is completed, not merely when the inbound record is drafted or shipped.

body.text: Answer: It applies an operation to selected inbound records.

questions.question: What is an outbound transaction?

body.text: Answer: An outbound transaction records inventory leaving a warehouse.

questions.question: Why does the Outbound Draft page say “No items found”?

body.text: Answer: It means no draft records match the current filters.

body.text: Answer: The exact timing is not stated on the list page.

questions.question: What is the Inventory Log?

body.text: Answer: Inventory Log is the stock-movement audit trail. It records quantities entering and leaving inventory and the reason for each movement.

questions.question: What is Seller SKU?

body.text: Answer: Seller SKU is the SKU associated with the seller or marketplace product involved in the stock movement.

questions.question: What does Stock In Quantity mean?

body.text: Answer: It records how many units were added in that transaction.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="0000052E"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It records how many units were added in that transaction.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: A zero means the transaction did not add stock.

questions.question: What does Purpose mean?

body.text: Answer: Purpose explains why the inventory changed.

questions.question: What does Operation Time mean?

body.text: Answer: It is the recorded date and time when the stock movement was processed.

body.text: If the time differs from the order time, synchronization or processing may have occurred later.

questions.question: Why should I select a warehouse?

body.text: Answer: The same SKU can exist in multiple warehouses. Selecting a warehouse prevents movements from different locations from being mixed together.

questions.question: What is the purpose of Order Management?

body.text: Answer: It manages orders from the time they enter the ERP until they are packed, transferred to fulfillment, shipped, delivered, returned, or cancelled.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000577"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It manages orders from the time they enter the ERP until they are packed, transferred to fulfillment, shipped, delivered, returned, or cancelled.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: It also supports manually created orders and return-order management.

body.text: Answer: It identifies the product or variation included in the order.

body.text: Answer: It identifies the marketplace from which the order originated.

questions.question: What is the Store column?

body.text: Answer: It identifies the authorized marketplace store that received the order.

questions.question: What is the Warehouse Package Number?

body.text: Answer: It is the ERP or warehouse reference for the package prepared during fulfillment.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005CD"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It is the ERP or warehouse reference for the package prepared during fulfillment.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: It may differ from the marketplace order number and courier tracking number.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005CE"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It may differ from the marketplace order number and courier tracking number.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

questions.question: What is a Tracking Number?

body.text: Answer: It is the courier’s shipment identifier. It is used to follow the parcel after booking or dispatch.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005D0"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It is the courier’s shipment identifier. It is used to follow the parcel after booking or dispatch.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

questions.question: Why might the tracking number be missing?

<w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005D3"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="71"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Courier booking has not occurred.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: The order has not reached the required stage.

<w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005D5"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="71"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Booking failed.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

<w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005D6"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="71"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="0" w:beforeAutospacing="0" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The seller arranged delivery separately.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

questions.question: What is Create Time?

body.text: Answer: It indicates when the order or corresponding ERP record was created.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005DA"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It indicates when the order or corresponding ERP record was created.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: It may differ from payment time, processing time, and shipment time.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005DB"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It may differ from payment time, processing time, and shipment time.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

questions.question: What does Status mean?

body.text: Answer: It shows the order’s current ERP processing state.

body.text: The marketplace or courier may maintain a separate status.

questions.question: What does Details do?

body.text: Answer: Details opens additional information about the selected order.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005E0"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Details opens additional information about the selected order.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: It may include products, quantities, addresses, shipment information, status history, and other order-level information.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005E1"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It may include products, quantities, addresses, shipment information, status history, and other order-level information.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: Answer: Actions opens the operations available for that order.
