body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005FD"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It indicates that the ERP completed the packing operation without a reported error.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

questions.question: What does Pack Failed mean?

body.text: Answer: It indicates that packing did not complete successfully.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000005FF"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It indicates that packing did not complete successfully.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: Possible causes include unavailable stock, missing mapping, invalid order data, warehouse problems, or a system error.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000600"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Possible causes include unavailable stock, missing mapping, invalid order data, warehouse problems, or a system error.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: Answer: It identifies orders that cannot currently be fulfilled because the required stock is unavailable.

questions.question: What does Exchange/Add mean?

body.text: Answer: It identifies orders where a product SKU may need to be replaced or supplemented.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000605"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It identifies orders where a product SKU may need to be replaced or supplemented.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: Any substitute should match the intended product and be authorized before processing.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000606"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Any substitute should match the intended product and be authorized before processing.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

questions.question: What does Platform Processing mean?

body.text: Answer: It indicates that the marketplace is still processing the order or that the ERP is waiting for a platform-side result.

questions.question: What is the Processed Orders page?

body.text: Answer: It contains orders that have passed the initial packing or processing stage and are ready for the next fulfillment operation.

questions.question: What does Push do?

body.text: Answer: Push sends selected processed orders to the next connected fulfillment, warehouse, marketplace, or logistics stage.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000615"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Push sends selected processed orders to the next connected fulfillment, warehouse, marketplace, or logistics stage.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

questions.question: What does Pushing mean?

body.text: Answer: It indicates that the ERP has started the push request but has not yet received a final result.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000621"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It indicates that the ERP has started the push request but has not yet received a final result.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: Answer: Withdraw likely removes or recalls an order from a previously pushed state.

questions.question: What is the To Pickup page?

body.text: Answer: It contains parcels prepared for courier collection or another handoff step.

questions.question: What should happen before an order reaches To Pickup?

body.text: Answer: The order should normally be processed, packed, and prepared for courier handoff.

questions.question: What does Move to Shipped do?

body.text: Answer: It manually advances selected orders from the pickup stage to the shipped stage.

body.text: Answer: The interface may permit manual movement, but doing so would make the ERP status inaccurate.

body.text: Answer: Cancellation after shipment may not be possible through the normal cancellation workflow. It may require courier interception, return handling, or marketplace support.

questions.question: What is the Completed Orders page?

body.text: Answer: It contains orders whose normal fulfillment lifecycle has finished.

body.text: Depending on the platform, completion may mean delivered, buyer-confirmed, or finalized after a settlement period.

questions.question: Does Completed always mean payment was settled?

body.text: Answer: Not necessarily. Delivery completion and financial settlement can be separate marketplace events.

Delivery completion and financial settlement can be separate marketplace events.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

questions.question: Can a completed order still be returned?

body.text: Answer: Yes. Marketplaces can permit returns or refunds after delivery, subject to their policies.

body.text: Answer: It requests updated return information from connected marketplaces.

body.text: Answer: A courier booking request has started but has not received a final result.

questions.question: What is a Platform Manual Order?

body.text: Answer: It is a manually created ERP order based on information from a marketplace shipment or label when automatic order import is unavailable or incomplete.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000721"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It is a manually created ERP order based on information from a marketplace shipment or label when automatic order import is unavailable or incomplete.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

questions.question: How is it different from a regular Manual Order?

body.text: Answer: Manual Order is created directly as an independent ERP order.

questions.question: Does every warehouse maintain separate inventory?

body.text: Answer: Usually, yes. A Merchant SKU can have different quantities in different warehouses.

A Merchant SKU can have different quantities in different warehouses.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

questions.question: Can the same SKU exist in several warehouses?

body.text: Answer: Yes. The same Merchant SKU can be assigned to several warehouses with a separate quantity in each one.

questions.question: Can two warehouses have the same name?

body.text: Answer: The system may technically permit similar names, but duplicate names create operational confusion.

questions.question: What happens if I enter the wrong country or ZIP code?

body.text: Answer: It can cause incorrect shipping calculations, unavailable courier services, failed deliveries, or inaccurate warehouse identification.

questions.question: Can I add a virtual warehouse?

body.text: Answer: That depends on the ERP’s warehouse-attribute options and business rules.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000007C8"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">That depends on the ERP’s warehouse-attribute options and business rules.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: A virtual warehouse should only be created when it represents a real operational need, such as consignment stock or marketplace-managed stock.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000007C9"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">A virtual warehouse should only be created when it represents a real operational need, such as consignment stock or marketplace-managed stock.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

questions.question: Does clicking Add New Warehouse immediately create one?

body.text: Answer: No. It should first open a creation form.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000007CB"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">No. It should first open a creation form.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: The warehouse is normally created only after the required information is entered and the final save or submit action is completed.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000007CC"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The warehouse is normally created only after the required information is entered and the final save or submit action is completed.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

questions.question: Can adding a warehouse affect existing stock?

body.text: Answer: Creating an empty warehouse should not move existing stock automatically.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000007CE"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Creating an empty warehouse should not move existing stock automatically.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: However, assigning SKUs, importing quantities, or changing the default warehouse can affect later operations.

questions.question: What does Warehouse Name mean?

body.text: Answer: It is the primary label used to identify the warehouse throughout the ERP.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000007D2"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It is the primary label used to identify the warehouse throughout the ERP.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: The same name may appear in inventory, inbound, outbound, order, and log filters.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000007D3"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The same name may appear in inventory, inbound, outbound, order, and log filters.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

questions.question: What does Warehouse Location mean?

body.text: Answer: It shows the geographical information associated with the warehouse.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000007D8"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It shows the geographical information associated with the warehouse.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: The displayed level of detail may include country, state, city, ZIP, or address.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000007D9"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The displayed level of detail may include country, state, city, ZIP, or address.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

questions.question: What does Total SKU mean?

body.text: Answer: It represents the number of SKU records associated with that warehouse.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000007DB"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It represents the number of SKU records associated with that warehouse.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: It should not automatically be interpreted as the total number of physical units.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000007DC"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It should not automatically be interpreted as the total number of physical units.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

questions.question: What is the difference between Total SKU and total inventory quantity?

body.text: Answer: Total SKU counts distinct inventory identities or warehouse SKU records.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000007DE"><w:pPr><w:numPr><w:ilvl w:val="0"/><w:numId w:val="192"/></w:numPr><w:spacing w:after="0" w:afterAutospacing="0" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:ind w:left="720" w:hanging="360"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Total SKU counts distinct inventory identities or warehouse SKU records.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: Total inventory quantity counts physical units.

questions.question: Why might Total SKU differ from the Merchant SKU total?

body.text: Answer: Not every Merchant SKU must exist in every warehouse.

questions.question: Can more than one warehouse be the default?

body.text: Answer: Normally, only one warehouse is the default within a particular scope.

body.text: Answer: Future operations may begin using the newly selected warehouse automatically.

questions.question: What is Current Plan?

body.text: Answer: It identifies the subscription plan assigned to the connected store.

body.text: Answer: It indicates how long the store’s current subscription remains active.

body.text: Answer: It controls whether eligible marketplace orders are accepted automatically.

questions.question: Will clicking Add Store immediately connect a store?

body.text: Answer: No. It should begin an authorization workflow.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="0000095E"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">No. It should begin an authorization workflow.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: The connection is normally created only after marketplace authentication and authorization are completed.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="0000095F"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">The connection is normally created only after marketplace authentication and authorization are completed.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

questions.question: Why might the marketplace ask me to sign in?

body.text: Answer: The marketplace needs to confirm which account and store are granting access to the ERP.

body.text: Always verify the marketplace domain before entering credentials.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000962"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Always verify the marketplace domain before entering credentials.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

questions.question: Should I share the marketplace password with ERP staff?

body.text: Answer: No. The store owner or authorized administrator should complete marketplace sign-in through the official authorization page.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000964"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">No. The store owner or authorized administrator should complete marketplace sign-in through the official authorization page.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: Passwords should not be sent through messages or documentation.

questions.question: What is a Sub Account?

body.text: Answer: A Sub Account is an additional ERP user operating under the main account.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000009AA"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">A Sub Account is an additional ERP user operating under the main account.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

questions.question: What is least-privilege access?

body.text: Answer: It means giving users only the permissions required for their work.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000009E3"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It means giving users only the permissions required for their work.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: For example, warehouse staff may not need subscription or account-management access.

questions.question: Should several employees share one Sub Account?

body.text: Answer: No. Each employee should have an individual account whenever possible.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000009E6"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">No. Each employee should have an individual account whenever possible.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: Shared accounts reduce accountability and make access removal more difficult.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="000009E7"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Shared accounts reduce accountability and make access removal more difficult.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

questions.question: How should a Sub Account password be created?

body.text: Answer: Use a strong, unique password that is not reused elsewhere.

body.text: Answer: An authorized administrator should promptly disable or remove the person’s access according to company policy.

questions.question: Should I delete or disable a former employee’s account?

body.text: Answer: Disabling is often safer because it blocks access while preserving the user record and history.

body.text: Deletion may be appropriate only when retention and audit requirements permit it.

questions.question: What is a role?

body.text: Answer: A role is a reusable set of permissions assigned to one or more Sub Accounts.

questions.question: What is Role Name?

body.text: Answer: It is the label describing the role’s intended responsibility.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000A2F"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It is the label describing the role’s intended responsibility.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: Use clear names such as “Warehouse Operator” rather than vague names such as “Role 1.”
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000A30"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Use clear names such as “Warehouse Operator” rather than vague names such as “Role 1.”</w:t></w:r></w:p>

questions.question: What does Sub Account Linking Status mean?

body.text: Answer: It shows whether the role is currently assigned to one or more Sub Accounts.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000A32"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It shows whether the role is currently assigned to one or more Sub Accounts.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: A linked role can affect active users.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000A33"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">A linked role can affect active users.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

questions.question: What does “Linked” mean?

body.text: Answer: It means at least one Sub Account is using the role.

questions.question: Should every role have delete permission?

body.text: Answer: No. Delete permission should be restricted to a small number of authorized administrators.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000A58"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">No. Delete permission should be restricted to a small number of authorized administrators.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: Answer: Usually not, unless their job includes store connections, user administration, or role management.

questions.question: What should I do if a user urgently needs temporary access?

body.text: Answer: Prefer a time-limited or narrowly scoped role if the ERP supports it.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000A93"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Prefer a time-limited or narrowly scoped role if the ERP supports it.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: Do not grant full administrator access simply because it is faster. Remove the temporary access when the task is complete.

questions.question: How do I open the Upgrade Plan page?

body.text: Answer: Click Upgrade Plan in the Store Plans area of the main sidebar or in a subscription reminder.

body.text: Answer: No. It opens the pricing and subscription-selection page.

body.text: Answer: The stores belonging to that marketplace become available for selection.

You should be able to select or clear platform checkboxes before choosing a plan.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

questions.question: Why must I select a store?

body.text: Answer: Subscriptions appear to be associated with individual marketplace stores.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000ADD"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Subscriptions appear to be associated with individual marketplace stores.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: The ERP needs to know which store or stores the plan should cover.

questions.question: How do I select a store?

body.text: Answer: First select its platform. Then select the checkbox beside the required store.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000AE0"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">First select its platform. Then select the checkbox beside the required store.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

questions.question: Can I select more than one store?

body.text: Answer: The page uses checkboxes, so multiple-store selection may be supported.

questions.question: What does the store count in the amount summary mean?

body.text: Answer: It indicates how many stores are included in the current subscription selection.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000AE5"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It indicates how many stores are included in the current subscription selection.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

questions.question: Why does the amount change when I select another store?

body.text: Answer: The pricing appears to be calculated per selected store.

questions.question: Can different stores use different plans?

body.text: Answer: The page applies the selected plan to the current platform/store selection.

body.text: If different stores require different plans, they may need to be purchased separately. Confirm this before completing checkout.

questions.question: Does changing currency convert the price?

body.text: Answer: It may change the displayed price using the ERP’s configured regional pricing or conversion rules.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000B32"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">It may change the displayed price using the ERP’s configured regional pricing or conversion rules.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: Do not assume it uses the live foreign-exchange rate.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000B33"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Do not assume it uses the live foreign-exchange rate.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

questions.question: Could my bank charge a conversion fee?

body.text: Answer: Yes. If the payment currency differs from the card or bank-account currency, the payment provider or bank may charge conversion fees.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000B35"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Yes. If the payment currency differs from the card or bank-account currency, the payment provider or bank may charge conversion fees.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: Answer: They often should, but the interface allows them to be selected separately.

questions.question: What does “Support for Shopee & TikTok” mean?

body.text: Answer: It indicates that the ERP can work with stores from those marketplaces when they are properly authorized and subscribed.

body.text: Answer: It suggests the plan does not impose a stated order-processing limit.

questions.question: What does Choose Plan do?

body.text: Answer: It begins the next purchase or checkout stage for the selected plan and stores.

body.text: Answer: Yes. Inventory is associated with warehouses, and warehouse filters appear across inventory workflows.

questions.question: Can the same SKU have stock in different warehouses?

body.text: Answer: Yes. Each warehouse can maintain a separate inventory record for the same Merchant SKU.

questions.question: What is the benefit of inbound statuses?

body.text: Answer: They show whether incoming stock is only planned, currently moving, or fully received.

body.text: This prevents expected stock from being confused with available stock.

body.text: Answer: It provides consistent identifiers, warehouse selection, status workflows, quantity tracking, and inventory logs.

questions.question: What is the value of an exception-based workflow?

body.text: Answer: Instead of manually checking every order, staff can concentrate on orders that require attention.

body.text: Answer: It is primarily an operational warehouse and marketplace ERP.

questions.question: What is the strongest reason to consider paid access?

body.text: Answer: The strongest reason is operational control: one system can connect the business’s marketplace products, internal SKUs, warehouses, inventory movements, orders, returns, store subscriptions, and staff permissions.

questions.question: How can I get a referral code?

body.text: Answer: After creating an account, you will receive a referral code whenever you purchase an available ERP subscription plan.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000DE7"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">After creating an account, you will receive a referral code whenever you purchase an available ERP subscription plan.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

questions.question: When will my referral code appear?

body.text: Answer: The referral code should appear after the plan purchase has been completed and the payment has been confirmed.

questions.question: Will I receive a referral code just for creating an account?

body.text: Answer: No. Creating an account alone is not enough. You must purchase an available subscription plan to receive a referral code.

questions.question: If I purchase another plan later, will I receive another referral code?

body.text: Answer: Yes. Every time you purchase a plan, you will receive a new referral code for that purchase.

questions.question: Does a referral code expire?

body.text: Answer: Normally, a referral code does not expire automatically.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000DFE"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Answer: </w:t></w:r><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">Normally, a referral code does not expire automatically.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

body.text: However, after someone successfully uses that code to purchase a plan, the code becomes invalid and cannot be used again.
body.xml: <w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidP="00000000" w:rsidRDefault="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000" xmlns:w14="http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml" w14:paraId="00000DFF"><w:pPr><w:spacing w:after="240" w:before="240" w:lineRule="auto"/><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/></w:rPr></w:pPr><w:r w:rsidDel="00000000" w:rsidR="00000000" w:rsidRPr="00000000"><w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Inter Tight" w:cs="Inter Tight" w:eastAsia="Inter Tight" w:hAnsi="Inter Tight"/><w:rtl w:val="0"/></w:rPr><w:t xml:space="preserve">However, after someone successfully uses that code to purchase a plan, the code becomes invalid and cannot be used again.</w:t></w:r></w:p>

questions.question: Can the same referral code be used by several people?

body.text: Answer: No. A referral code becomes invalid after it has been used successfully for an eligible plan purchase.

body.text: Answer: The reviewed ERP interface does not confirm a referral-code deletion function.

body.text: Normally, you do not need to delete it. An already-used code should become invalid automatically.

questions.question: How can the referral program help my business?

body.text: Answer: It can encourage existing customers to introduce new customers to the ERP.

body.text: Answer: No. It can encourage referrals, but it cannot guarantee purchases or business growth.

questions.question: What is Warehouse ERP used for?

body.text: Answer: Warehouse ERP helps a business manage marketplace stores, products, Merchant SKUs, inventory, warehouses, orders, manual orders, staff access, subscriptions, referrals, and gifts from one system.
